dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Winnie, a sweet-as-honey girl with a love for adventure!

Winnie doesn't need a pot of honey to make her day, just a good friend and plenty of toys! This girl loves playing fetch, especially with her favorite squeaky toy. Give her a toy to chase and you'll see her biggest, happiest smile!

When she's not busy playing, Winnie enjoys spending time with people and learning new things. She already knows “sit” and “place” and loves showing off her skills.

Life is a little sweeter with a friend by your side! Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Winnie’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: WINNIE
